name: AdScale AI Ads Meta/Google Ads
author: adscale

sections.description:
AdScale helps online stores grow faster with AI-powered advertising across multiple channels — all from one platform.
Since 2018, AdScale has been transforming eCommerce advertising through advanced AI and proprietary data signals that even Google and Meta can’t access. This gives our users a clear advantage: more accurate targeting, smarter campaigns, and better results.
Our AI is trained on insights from over 200 million eCommerce orders, giving online retailers a smarter way to scale through better data, automation, and results.
In addition to paid ads, AdScale makes it easy to run Email and SMS marketing — either within the platform or by integrating with your existing systems. Flexibility built in, so you can work the way you prefer.
Trusted by 7,000+ online stores in 120+ countries, and proudly maintaining a top-rated score on the Shopify App Store, AdScale helps brands simplify their marketing, improve ROI, and grow profitably.

⸻

Shopify App Rating: ★★★★★ 4.8/5
Google & Meta partners.

External Services

This plugin relies on external services to function properly. Below is a detailed explanation of each service, what data is sent, why it is sent, and links to the relevant privacy policies and terms.

1. WooCommerce REST API

  • Purpose: This plugin integrates with the WooCommerce REST API to retrieve and update store data.
  • What data is sent: Store settings, product information, and order details are retrieved or modified as needed.
  • When is data sent?: Data is sent when store synchronization occurs, during product updates, or when required by the plugin functionality.
  • Third-party provider: Automattic (WooCommerce)
  • Terms of Service: WooCommerce API Terms
  • Privacy Policy: WooCommerce Privacy

2. AdScale API

  • Purpose: The plugin uses the AdScale API for advanced marketing automation and performance tracking.
  • What data is sent:
    • Store metadata (e.g., store name, currency, country)
    • Product information (e.g., product names, descriptions, prices, images)
    • Customer activity (e.g., purchase events, cart actions) if enabled
  • When is data sent?: Data is sent during the initial setup, periodic synchronization, and when events related to marketing campaigns occur.
  • Third-party provider: AdScale LTD
  • Terms of Service: AdScale Terms
  • Privacy Policy: AdScale Privacy
